name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（单节点 TP=1 · MiaAI-Lab）
description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（176.9B，Mia-AiLab NVFP4 checkpoint ~99 GB）单节点 TP=1 vLLM 服务（1× DGX Spark）：26.82 GiB n-gram/PLE 查找表由 NVMe 内存映射离载（VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD=1 + MADV_RANDOM + POSIX_FADV prefetch，每 token 磁盘读 1,366→57 KiB）、MTP 训练草稿 k=3 投机 + 可选 reduced-vocabulary drafting（MTP_DRAFT_VOCAB，最大 +25% decode）、FP8 KV（≈1.85× KV 池）、262,144 原生上下文（YARN=1 → 524,288 YaRN）、推理默认开（reasoning 字段单独返回、可每请求关）、OpenAI API + 图片/视频多模态；宿主侧 HOST_RESERVE_GIB=26 封顶 GPU 预算（GMU 0.78）；sparkDash 实测 decode 单流 ~46.3 tok/s（4 流聚合 108.1）、prefill 峰值 ~2,265 tok/s @32k。源自 MiaAI-Lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Single-DGX-Spark（AGPL-3.0 配方参考）。
description_en: Single-node TP=1 vLLM serving for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (176.9B, Mia-AiLab NVFP4 checkpoint ~99 GB) on one DGX Spark: the 26.82 GiB n-gram/PLE lookup table is offloaded and memory-mapped from NVMe (VLLM_PLE_CPU_OFFLOAD=1 + MADV_RANDOM + POSIX_FADV prefetch, 1,366 -> 57 KiB disk read per token), MTP trained-draft k=3 speculation with optional reduced-vocabulary drafting (MTP_DRAFT_VOCAB, up to +25% decode), FP8 KV (~1.85x KV pool), 262,144 native context (YARN=1 -> 524,288 YaRN), reasoning on by default (separate reasoning field, disable per request), OpenAI API with image/video multimodal; host-side HOST_RESERVE_GIB=26 caps the GPU budget (GMU 0.78); measured with sparkDash - decode ~46.3 tok/s single-stream (108.1 aggregate at 4 streams), prefill peak ~2,265 tok/s @32k. Ported from MiaAI-Lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Single-DGX-Spark (AGPL-3.0 reference).

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: ACR 烘焙镜像（官方基镜像 vllm/vllm-openai:qwen38-flash-next + MiaAI 五项补丁：PLE layer prefetch、PLE offload 宿主握手、MTP draft vocab、ModelOpt MXFP8 回退、QSA FP8-KV）。源仓库在启动时改写容器内文件，Fireworks 一键部署用本烘焙镜像即可；换回官方原镜像会 PLE 离载死锁、FP8 KV 不可用。
variables.help_en: ACR-baked image (official vllm/vllm-openai:qwen38-flash-next base + all five MiaAI patches: PLE-layer prefetch, PLE offload host handshake, MTP draft vocab, ModelOpt MXFP8 fallback, QSA FP8-KV). The source repo rewrites vLLM files at launch; one-click Fireworks deploy uses this baked image. Stock image deadlocks PLE offload and breaks FP8 KV.

variables.label: 模型
variables.help: Mia-AiLab NVFP4 checkpoint（磁盘 ~99 GB；26.82 GiB 为 PLE 查找表，由 NVMe mmap 离载）。需已分发到节点 HF 缓存。
variables.help_en: Mia-AiLab NVFP4 checkpoint (~99 GB on disk; 26.82 GiB is the PLE lookup table, mmap-offloaded from NVMe). Must be distributed to the node HF cache.

variables.label: MTP 精简草稿词表（宿主文件路径）
variables.label_en: MTP reduced draft vocab (host file path)
variables.help: 空 = 不开（drafter 全 248,320 词表）；填宿主一行一个 token id 的文件（用源 build_draft_vocab.py 从模型自身语料生成，256k 档 65,536 行 ≈ 0.16 GiB），drafter 只对子集 argmax——目标模型逐 token 校验，不改输出，decode +25%（单流最大提升）。
variables.help_en: Empty = off (full 248,320-vocab drafter); set a host path to a token-id-per-line file (build with the upstream build_draft_vocab.py; 65,536 rows at 256k tier ~0.16 GiB) so the drafter argmaxes over the subset only - the target model verifies every token, output unchanged, decode +25% (the largest single-stream win).

variables.label: 服务端口
variables.help: 源默认 8888——但 comfy-h3.service 会轮询 127.0.0.1:8888 并拉起 ComfyUI（GPU 共租者）：该服务在用时 8888 会触发它与本服务抢 GPU，须先 disable 之或用其它端口（如 8890）。
variables.help_en: Upstream default 8888 - but comfy-h3.service polls 127.0.0.1:8888 and launches ComfyUI (a GPU co-tenant): while active it would contend for GPU if served on 8888. Disable that service first or use another port (e.g. 8890).

variables.label: 上下文长度（YARN=0）
variables.help: YARN=0 时服务的上下文；原生上限 262,144，超过会被拒（设 YARN=1 走 YaRN）。
variables.help_en: Context served at YARN=0; the native cap is 262,144, anything above is refused (set YARN=1 for YaRN).

variables.label: YaRN 长上下文
variables.help: 0（默认）= 原生 rope（用 MAX_MODEL_LEN）；1 = YaRN rope → 服务 YARN_MAX_MODEL_LEN（factor 2.0 → 512k）。长窗换一点短上下文精度，非 512k 需求勿开。
variables.help_en: 0 (default) = native rope (uses MAX_MODEL_LEN); 1 = YaRN rope, serves YARN_MAX_MODEL_LEN (factor 2.0 -> 512k). YaRN trades some short-context accuracy; leave off unless you need > 262k.

variables.label: YaRN 上下文长度
variables.help: YARN=1 时服务的长度；仅 524,288 经源仓库验证——1M 需 ~28.8 GiB KV（BF16）会冲破单机预算，切勿抬到 1M。
variables.help_en: Length served at YARN=1; only 524,288 is validated upstream - 1M needs ~28.8 GiB KV (BF16) and blows the single-Spark budget, so do not push to 1M.

variables.label: KV 缓存精度
variables.help: fp8（默认）= 主 KV 用 fp8-e4m3，池 ≈1.85×（12 层全注意力压缩 ~84% 字节；QSA 侧/compressor 仍 BF16）→ 512k 下 2.73× 满请求；代价小：#32k prefill −6.1%、#400k −2.7%、decode −4%，推理套件 11/11。auto = BF16。需镜像含 QSA FP8-KV 补丁。
variables.help_en: fp8 (default) = main KV in fp8-e4m3, ~1.85x pool (only the 12 full-attention layers shrink ~84% of bytes; QSA side/compressor stay BF16) -> 2.73x a full request at 512k; small cost: -6.1% prefill @32k, -2.7% @400k, -4% decode, 11/11 reasoning suite. auto = BF16. Requires the QSA FP8-KV patch in the image.

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 上游 09-05 起宿主侧封顶预算：GMU × MemTotal ≤ MemTotal − HOST_RESERVE_GIB(26)。shipped 档源码按取整推导出 GMU 0.78（GPU 94.87 GiB → fp8 KV ~16.46 GiB = 992,584-token 池，3.79× 满 262k 请求）。调高须同时按源的安全规则留宿主余量（MemAvailable ≥ ~10 GiB），耗尽统一内存会挂内核。
variables.help_en: Upstream 09-05 hosts the budget from the host side: GMU x MemTotal <= MemTotal - HOST_RESERVE_GIB(26). The shipped profile derives GMU 0.78 (94.87 GiB to the GPU -> ~16.46 GiB fp8 KV = 992,584-token pool, 3.79x a full 262k request). Raising it must keep host MemAvailable >= ~10 GiB per the upstream safety rules; exhausting the unified pool hangs the kernel.

variables.label: 最大并发序列数
variables.help: 源已测 1/2/3/4 流：单流 ~46.3 tok/s，4 流聚合 ~108.1 tok/s；KV 池 3.79× 满 262k 请求，长上下文是并发上限而非吞吐旋钮（短上下文聚合到 8 流 ~114 tok/s）。
variables.help_en: Measured at 1/2/3/4 streams upstream: ~46.3 tok/s single-stream, ~108.1 tok/s aggregate at 4. The KV pool holds 3.79x a full 262k request, so this is the long-context limit, not a throughput knob (aggregate keeps rising to ~114 at 8 streams on short contexts).

variables.label: 单批最大 token 数
variables.help: 源默认 2048；chunked prefill 已开。抬 8192 买 ~11% prefill / ~10% TTFT，代价 ~3% KV 池，先读源 README prefill 表。
variables.help_en: Upstream default 2048; chunked prefill is on. Raising to 8192 buys ~11% prefill and ~10% TTFT out of ~3% of the KV pool; read the upstream README prefill table first.

variables.label: CUDA Graph 捕获规格
variables.help: auto（默认）= 源随 .env 的每批可构建宽度 (1+K)×S for S∈1..MAX_NUM_SEQS ——vLLM 自带列表在 MTP=3 会漏 3/5 序列批(PAD/无图)；逗号列表显式指定；空 = vLLM 默认。
variables.help_en: auto (default, upstream .env) = every verify-batch width (1+K)xS for S in 1..MAX_NUM_SEQS - vLLM's own list misses 3/5-sequence batches at MTP=3 (padded/eager); a comma list sets them explicitly; empty = the vLLM default.

variables.label: MTP 投机 token 数
variables.help: MTP 训练草稿头 k=3（0 = 关，省 ~1.49 GiB）；多模态请求自动回退到非投机（草稿模型吃不了多模态嵌入），文本请求不受影响。
variables.help_en: MTP trained-draft speculation k=3 (0 = off, saves ~1.49 GiB); multimodal requests automatically fall back to non-speculative (the draft model cannot take embeddings), text requests are unaffected.

variables.label: PLE 打包表宿主目录
variables.help: 封装 PLE 表的宿主目录（挂到容器 /root/.cache/vllm）。发布前须在宿主先构建好 <org>--<name>/*.packed_u8（源 build_ple_packed_table.py，一次性 ~27 GB），容器启动会检查，缺则退出。
variables.help_en: Host dir holding the packed PLE table (mounted to /root/.cache/vllm). Output must be built once on the host before publish (<org>--<name>/*.packed_u8, via the upstream build_ple_packed_table.py, one-time ~27 GB); the container checks for it and exits if missing.

variables.label: HuggingFace Token
variables.help: 受 gating 的模型授权 token；模型已由管理平台分发到缓存时通常可留空。
variables.help_en: Auth token for gated models; usually empty when the model is pre-distributed to the cache.
